notes: "HUANDENG is a desktop slide editor built for presentations that are never really finished: a lab's results deck, a thesis talk, a product overview. It keeps one editable source of slides, lets you assemble several talks from it, and lets an AI agent edit the same document through the same writer you use. This talk walks through the idea, the project structure, a real working session, and how to get involved on GitHub."
